findings.title: ChromaDB CVE-2026-45829 — Pre-Auth Code Injection via Trust-Remote-Code in /collections Endpoint
findings.summary: ChromaDB's /api/v2 collections endpoint accepts a model repository with trust_remote_code=true from unauthenticated network clients and executes attacker-controlled Python on the server, providing pre-auth RCE on a widely deployed AI/RAG infrastructure component.

findings.title: Microsoft Azure Local Disconnected Operations CVE-2026-42822 — Unauthenticated Network Privilege Escalation, No Patch Available
findings.summary: Unauthenticated network attacker can elevate privileges over the Azure Local Disconnected Operations control plane (CWE-287), with no patch currently available, exposing on-prem sovereign and regulated-workload deployments to admin-level compromise.

findings.title: SGLang LLM-Serving Framework — Two RCEs + Path Traversal With No Patch (CERT/CC VU#777338)
findings.summary: CMU CERT/CC disclosed two RCEs (pickle and dill deserialization) plus an unauthenticated path-traversal in SGLang's multimodal pipeline; the scheduler binds to 0.0.0.0 by default, maintainers were unresponsive, and no patch is published.

findings.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS CVE-2026-0265 — Authentication Bypass via Cloud Authentication Service Signature Verification Flaw
findings.affected_technology: PAN-OS on PA-Series, VM-Series, Panorama (virtual/M-Series); CAS-enabled login interfaces
findings.summary: PAN-OS Cloud Authentication Service performs incorrect signature verification when attached to a login interface, enabling authentication bypass; researcher Harsh Jaiswal disputes vendor's 7.2 rating and claims GlobalProtect exploitation, with full technical details expected the week of 2026-05-18.

findings.title: OpenClaw 'Claw Chain' Expansion — Cyera Publishes 4-CVE Chain (was 3); MCP Loopback CVE-2026-44118 Completes Sandbox-to-Owner Primitive
findings.affected_technology: OpenClaw AI assistant (60,000+ publicly accessible instances)
findings.summary: Cyera's 2026-05-18 'Claw Chain' writeup adds CVE-2026-44118 (MCP loopback → owner-level privilege elevation) to the previously covered 3-CVE OpenShell sandbox race-condition cluster, completing a fully documented sandbox-to-host-takeover primitive against the lagging OpenClaw fleet.

findings.title: First Shai-Hulud Worm Clones in the Wild — Non-TeamPCP Actor Publishes 4 Malicious npm Packages Using Leaked Source
findings.affected_technology: npm registry (chalk-tempalte, @deadcode09284814/axios-util, axois-utils, color-style-utils); developer machines and CI runners
findings.summary: OXsecurity observed the first non-TeamPCP weaponization of the leaked Shai-Hulud source within 72h of the BreachForums release — four malicious npm packages from _deadcode09284814_ (three Axios typosquats) exfiltrating credentials/wallets to 87e0bbc636999.lhr.life.

findings.title: 7-Eleven Salesforce Breach — 600K+ Records Stolen by ShinyHunters (CoinbaseCartel Cluster)
findings.affected_technology: Salesforce CRM at 7-Eleven (franchise applications, corporate data)
findings.summary: 7-Eleven confirmed 2026-05-18 that ShinyHunters stole 600,000+ Salesforce records (intrusion 2026-04-08, $250,000 demand) — same CoinbaseCartel/Scattered Spider cluster responsible for the 2026-05-18 Grafana GitHub codebase theft.

findings.title: CISA Contractor Leaked AWS GovCloud Credentials via Public 'Private-CISA' GitHub Repo
findings.affected_technology: CISA Landing Zone DevSecOps environment (AWS GovCloud) — administrative credentials and artifactory access
findings.summary: GitGuardian researcher Guillaume Valadon found a CISA-contractor-owned public GitHub repository 'Private-CISA' exposing AWS GovCloud admin credentials, internal-system passwords, and artifactory tokens until 2026-05-15; the owner had explicitly disabled GitHub's push-protection feature.

findings.title: AWS Amazon Redshift Python Connector CVE-2026-8838 — eval() on Server Data Enables MITM Code Execution in BI Clients
findings.affected_technology: amazon-redshift-python-driver < 2.1.14 (Airflow workers, dbt environments, analyst notebooks, BI tools)
findings.summary: The Redshift Python driver's vector in() function passes server-returned data to Python's eval(), letting a MITM-positioned attacker execute arbitrary Python in BI clients/Airflow workers — second Redshift driver code-injection in a week after JDBC CVE-2026-8178.

noted.summary: THN's multi-vendor wrap-up (2026-05-18) reveals the n8n batch is 5 CVEs total — adds xml2js prototype pollution and global prototype pollution via XML Node (both fixed in 1.123.32, earlier than the 1.123.43 patches covered 2026-05-16); documentation alignment only, no new defensive action.
External file-name control allows an authenticated remote attacker to read sensitive files (CVSS 9.6); patched in 2026.2+. Authenticated-only — narrower than recent Ivanti EPMM / Cloud SSA exposures.

noted.product: Linux kernel (Copy Fail public multi-language PoC)
noted.summary: Andrei Berestov posted multi-language exploit code (C/Python/Perl/x86_64 NASM) on oss-security 2026-05-18; all stable kernels patched 2026-04-30, item already in KEV — operational urgency rises but already extensively covered.
Pre-auth stack overflow in SNMPv3 USM handler (snmp_parse_inbound_frame() via msgAuthenticationParameters); primarily embedded/IoT firmware concern (CVSS 10.0).

Authenticated OS-command injection via the application-name parameter — shell metacharacters bypass cleanAppName (CVSS 9.9); self-hosted deployment platform with small footprint but full host RCE post-auth.
Authenticated IDOR enables session hijack and message access (CVSS 7.1) — usually internal but exposed instances exist.
Zip-slip via uploaded archive enables arbitrary file write to RCE (CVSS 7.2) + reflected XSS via fsNick cookie (CVSS 3.9); ERP software for SMBs.
Pre-auth path-traversal enables arbitrary file deletion (CVSS 9.1); niche product but no-auth file delete is destructive.
LDAP injection in LDAPStoreHelper (CVSS 6.5); Bouncy Castle is bundled into many Java enterprise stacks but impact depends on whether the application exposes LDAPStoreHelper to untrusted input.

noted.product: Vim (netrw bookmark history + cucumber filetype plugin)
noted.summary: Multiple vimscript code-injection CVEs (oss-security 2026-05-17) affecting Vim < 9.2.495 / 9.2.496; client-side, out-of-scope for Watchtower, logged for completeness.
Metric-injection, out-of-bounds write, password truncation issues in Perl modules (oss-security 2026-05-16/17/18); low-impact, client-only.

Cloudflare published evaluation of cyber frontier models (Anthropic Mythos, OpenAI gpt-5.5-Cyber, GPT-5.5) against live infrastructure code (2026-05-18); joins MDASH/Daybreak/Glasswing AI vuln-finder disclosure cluster — calibration signal, not a finding.
BleepingComputer 2026-05-18: AppleScript-based fake Apple security-update lure, browser/wallet/iCloud/Telegram data theft; client-side, out-of-scope but worth endpoint-team awareness.
INTERPOL/MENA operation arrested 201 individuals and seized 53 phishing-as-a-service servers (2026-05-18); reduces active phishing-kit operator pool short-term, not a vulnerability.

BleepingComputer/THN re-coverage 2026-05-17 of the Tycoon2FA device-code phishing campaign already noted in MEMORY 2026-05-18; eSentire research confirms device-code phishing up 37x year-over-year with 10+ phishing-as-a-service platforms supporting the tactic.
